content.name: Unarmored Defense
entries: Beginning at 1st level, while you are wearing no armor and not wielding a shield, your AC equals 10 + your Dexterity modifier + your Wisdom modifier.

content.name: Unarmored Defense
entries: While you aren't wearing armor or wielding a {@item Shield|SRD52}, your base {@variantrule Armor Class|SRD52} equals 10 plus your Dexterity and Wisdom modifiers.
